fruits.extendedStory: Building began here in 1015, and the work ran on for centuries. That is why the monument record calls it a major work of both Romanesque and Gothic art. Its architect was Erwin von Steinbach. Some of the glass in its windows has been there since the thirteenth century. Inside, an astronomical clock sends its apostles filing past at half past twelve, every day.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Bau begann 1015, und gearbeitet wurde daran über Jahrhunderte. Deshalb nennt das staatliche Denkmalregister sie ein Hauptwerk der romanischen und der gotischen Kunst. Ihr Baumeister war Erwin von Steinbach. Ein Teil der Fenster trägt Glas aus dem dreizehnten Jahrhundert. Drinnen schickt eine astronomische Uhr jeden Tag um halb eins ihre Apostel vorbei.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Building began here in 1015, and the work ran on for centuries. That is why the monument record calls it a major work of both Romanesque and Gothic art. Its architect was Erwin von Steinbach. Some of the glass in its windows has been there since the thirteenth century. Inside, an astronomical clock sends its apostles filing past at half past twelve, every day.

localizedStory.de: Die Turmspitze wurde 1439 fertig. Danach stand in der Christenheit lange nichts Höheres.
localizedStory.en: The spire was finished in 1439. For a long time after that, nothing in Christendom stood taller.

fruits.name: Cathédrale Notre-Dame
fruits.story: The spire was finished in 1439. For a long time after that, nothing in Christendom stood taller.

fruits.extendedStory: The palace was designed by Robert de Cotte, and 1742 is the date it carries. Baroque means grand and deeply carved, built to impress anyone passing in the street. It stands right against the cathedral, so the two are almost always seen in one look. A palace and a church of very different centuries, sharing one small square.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Palast wurde von Robert de Cotte entworfen, und er trägt das Datum 1742. Barock heißt groß und tief geschnitten, gebaut, um jeden auf der Straße zu beeindrucken. Er steht dicht am Münster, deshalb sieht man beide fast immer in einem Blick. Ein Palast und eine Kirche aus ganz verschiedenen Jahrhunderten, an einem kleinen Platz.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The palace was designed by Robert de Cotte, and 1742 is the date it carries. Baroque means grand and deeply carved, built to impress anyone passing in the street. It stands right against the cathedral, so the two are almost always seen in one look. A palace and a church of very different centuries, sharing one small square.

localizedStory.de: Robert de Cotte entwarf diesen Palast, das Datum darauf ist 1742. Er steht direkt neben dem Münster.
localizedStory.en: Robert de Cotte drew this palace, and 1742 is the date it carries. It stands right beside the cathedral.

fruits.name: Palais Rohan
fruits.story: Robert de Cotte drew this palace, and 1742 is the date it carries. It stands right beside the cathedral.

fruits.extendedStory: The towers went up to hold the point where the Ill runs into the city. They stand on the banks and on the tips of small islands in the river. Three of the four are still here, kept because the city went on using them as jails. Prisoners cut graffiti into the oak walls of the cells, and tree rings date those cells to 1529. You cannot go in today, so the towers have been laser scanned in three dimensions instead.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Türme entstanden, um die Stelle zu halten, an der die Ill in die Stadt läuft. Sie stehen am Ufer und auf den Spitzen kleiner Inseln im Fluss. Drei der vier stehen noch, weil die Stadt sie weiter als Gefängnis nutzte. Häftlinge ritzten Zeichen in die Eichenwände der Zellen. Jahresringe datieren diese Zellen auf 1529. Hinein kommt man heute nicht, deshalb hat man die Türme in drei Dimensionen gescannt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The towers went up to hold the point where the Ill runs into the city. They stand on the banks and on the tips of small islands in the river. Three of the four are still here, kept because the city went on using them as jails. Prisoners cut graffiti into the oak walls of the cells, and tree rings date those cells to 1529. You cannot go in today, so the towers have been laser scanned in three dimensions instead.

localizedStory.de: Gedeckte Brücken ohne Dach. Die Ziegeldächer kamen 1784 herunter, der Name blieb.
localizedStory.en: Covered bridges with no roofs. The tile roofs came off in 1784 and the name stayed anyway.

fruits.name: Ponts Couverts
fruits.story: Covered bridges with no roofs. The tile roofs came off in 1784 and the name stayed anyway.

fruits.extendedStory: The tower appears in writing in 1378, under the name Henckers Turn. The executioner himself does not seem to have done his work here. What the tower did hold was one of the city's jails. Its prisoners were kept on bread and water by a warden on the city payroll. Madame Tussaud, who founded the London waxworks, came from the Grosholtz family of Strasbourg executioners.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Turm taucht 1378 in den Schriften auf, unter dem Namen Henckers Turn. Der Henker selbst scheint hier nicht gearbeitet zu haben. Der Turm war eines der Gefängnisse der Stadt. Die Gefangenen bekamen Brot und Wasser, bewacht von einem Wärter im Dienst der Stadt. Madame Tussaud, die das Londoner Wachsfigurenkabinett gründete, stammt aus der Straßburger Henkersfamilie Grosholtz.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The tower appears in writing in 1378, under the name Henckers Turn. The executioner himself does not seem to have done his work here. What the tower did hold was one of the city's jails. Its prisoners were kept on bread and water by a warden on the city payroll. Madame Tussaud, who founded the London waxworks, came from the Grosholtz family of Strasbourg executioners.

localizedStory.de: Der Henkersturm hat seinen Namen vom Haus des Henkers, nicht von seiner Arbeit. Es stand in dieser Straße.
localizedStory.en: The executioner's tower is named for his house, not his work. It stood on the street at your feet.

fruits.name: Tour du Bourreau
fruits.story: The executioner's tower is named for his house, not his work. It stood on the street at your feet.

fruits.extendedStory: Joseph Massol drew this building in 1736. He had a full year of it. The prefecture a few streets off is also his, and carries that same date. Both are baroque, which means heavy stonework and deep carving, made to look expensive. Walk from one to the other and you are following a single pair of hands.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Joseph Massol entwarf dieses Haus 1736. Er hatte ein volles Jahr davon. Auch die Präfektur ein paar Straßen weiter stammt von ihm und trägt dasselbe Datum. Beide sind barock, also schweres Mauerwerk und tiefe Schnitzerei, gebaut, um teuer auszusehen. Wer von einem zum anderen geht, folgt derselben Handschrift.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Joseph Massol drew this building in 1736. He had a full year of it. The prefecture a few streets off is also his, and carries that same date. Both are baroque, which means heavy stonework and deep carving, made to look expensive. Walk from one to the other and you are following a single pair of hands.

localizedStory.de: Joseph Massol entwarf dieses Rathaus 1736. Im selben Jahr entwarf er die Präfektur, ein paar Straßen weiter.
localizedStory.en: Joseph Massol drew this town hall in 1736. That same year he drew the prefecture, streets away.

fruits.name: Hôtel de Ville
fruits.story: Joseph Massol drew this town hall in 1736. That same year he drew the prefecture, streets away.

fruits.extendedStory: The opera house opened in 1821 to a design by Jean Villot. It faces the Place Broglie, the long open square that runs along the north of the island. In 1870 a fire caught the building, half a century after it opened. It was brought back, and it is still the city's opera house. The date it carries and the year it opened are the same.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Opernhaus wurde 1821 nach einem Entwurf von Jean Villot eröffnet. Es liegt am Place Broglie, dem langen offenen Platz im Norden der Insel. 1870 brannte das Gebäude, ein halbes Jahrhundert nach der Eröffnung. Es wurde wieder aufgebaut und ist bis heute das Opernhaus der Stadt. Das Datum am Bau und das Jahr der Eröffnung sind dasselbe.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The opera house opened in 1821 to a design by Jean Villot. It faces the Place Broglie, the long open square that runs along the north of the island. In 1870 a fire caught the building, half a century after it opened. It was brought back, and it is still the city's opera house. The date it carries and the year it opened are the same.

localizedStory.de: Jean Villots Opernhaus wurde 1821 am Place Broglie eröffnet. 1870 brannte es, und es steht immer noch.
localizedStory.en: Jean Villot's opera house opened on Place Broglie in 1821. Fire took it in 1870, and it is still here.

fruits.name: Opéra du Rhin
fruits.story: Jean Villot's opera house opened on Place Broglie in 1821. Fire took it in 1870, and it is still here.

fruits.extendedStory: The city put up this warehouse in 1358. Goods changed here between the flat boats of the Ill and the barges of the Rhine. Merchants had to set their load down and pay the duty before they went on. A landing stage went in beside it in 1393, with two huge cranes. Their treadwheel could lift close to a tonne.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Stadt errichtete dieses Lagerhaus 1358. Hier wechselten die Waren zwischen den flachen Booten der Ill und den Kähnen des Rheins. Die Kaufleute mussten ihre Ladung absetzen und Zoll zahlen, bevor sie weiterfuhren. 1393 kam daneben ein Landesteg dazu, mit zwei gewaltigen Kränen. Ihr Treterad konnte fast eine Tonne heben.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The city put up this warehouse in 1358. Goods changed here between the flat boats of the Ill and the barges of the Rhine. Merchants had to set their load down and pay the duty before they went on. A landing stage went in beside it in 1393, with two huge cranes. Their treadwheel could lift close to a tonne.

localizedStory.de: Jede Fracht auf dem Rhein musste in Straßburg halten. Hier wurde sie abgeladen und verzollt.
localizedStory.en: Every cargo on the Rhine had to stop at Strasbourg, and this is the shed where it was set down and taxed.

fruits.name: Ancienne douane
fruits.story: Every cargo on the Rhine had to stop at Strasbourg, and this is the shed where it was set down and taxed.

fruits.extendedStory: The place has been called the aubette since the late eighteenth century. The guard was changed out front every day at dawn, and l'aube is French for dawn. In 1928 Sophie Taeuber-Arp, Hans Jean Arp and Theo van Doesburg split its rooms between them. The public disapproved, and within months the managers were adding trim of their own. The rooms were called the Sistine Chapel of modern art, and they opened again on 8 June 2006.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Aubette heißt der Ort seit dem späten achtzehnten Jahrhundert. Vor dem Haus wurde jeden Tag im Morgengrauen die Wache gewechselt, und l'aube ist französisch für Morgengrauen. 1928 teilten sich Sophie Taeuber-Arp, Hans Jean Arp und Theo van Doesburg die Räume. Das Publikum lehnte ab, und schon nach wenigen Monaten hängten die Betreiber eigenen Zierrat dazu. Die Räume gelten als die Sixtinische Kapelle der modernen Kunst. Am 8. Juni 2006 öffneten sie wieder.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The place has been called the aubette since the late eighteenth century. The guard was changed out front every day at dawn, and l'aube is French for dawn. In 1928 Sophie Taeuber-Arp, Hans Jean Arp and Theo van Doesburg split its rooms between them. The public disapproved, and within months the managers were adding trim of their own. The rooms were called the Sistine Chapel of modern art, and they opened again on 8 June 2006.

localizedStory.de: Die Räume hinter dieser Fassade wurden 1938 übermalt und erst 1977 wiederentdeckt.
localizedStory.en: The rooms behind this front were painted over in 1938 and were not found again until 1977.

fruits.name: Aubette 1928
fruits.story: The rooms behind this front were painted over in 1938 and were not found again until 1977.

fruits.extendedStory: The church takes its name from Thomas the Apostle. Building began in 1196, and the records give 1521 as the year it opened. The style is Gothic, so look for pointed arches rather than round ones. Outside, the street at its door is named after Martin Luther. That is a fitting address for a protestant church.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kirche ist nach dem Apostel Thomas benannt. Der Bau begann 1196, und die Quellen nennen 1521 als Jahr der Eröffnung. Der Stil ist gotisch, also spitze Bögen statt runder. Draußen trägt die Straße vor der Tür den Namen Martin Luthers. Für eine protestantische Kirche ist das eine passende Adresse.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The church takes its name from Thomas the Apostle. Building began in 1196, and the records give 1521 as the year it opened. The style is Gothic, so look for pointed arches rather than round ones. Outside, the street at its door is named after Martin Luther. That is a fitting address for a protestant church.

localizedStory.de: Baubeginn war 1196. Die Straße vor der Tür heißt Rue Martin Luther.
localizedStory.en: Work began in 1196. The street at its door is called Rue Martin Luther.

fruits.name: Église protestante Saint-Thomas
fruits.story: Work began in 1196. The street at its door is called Rue Martin Luther.

fruits.extendedStory: The written record for a church on this spot reaches back to the year 601. It is named for Saint Peter. The young in its name separates it from the old Saint Peter's elsewhere on the island. What stands here now is Gothic, built with pointed arches and tall windows. The square outside took the church's name and kept it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der schriftliche Nachweis für eine Kirche an dieser Stelle reicht bis ins Jahr 601 zurück. Sie ist nach Petrus benannt. Das Jung im Namen trennt sie von Alt Sankt Peter anderswo auf der Insel. Was heute hier steht, ist gotisch, mit spitzen Bögen und hohen Fenstern. Der Platz davor hat den Namen der Kirche übernommen und behalten.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The written record for a church on this spot reaches back to the year 601. It is named for Saint Peter. The young in its name separates it from the old Saint Peter's elsewhere on the island. What stands here now is Gothic, built with pointed arches and tall windows. The square outside took the church's name and kept it.

localizedStory.de: Seit 601 steht auf diesem Platz eine Kirche. Der Platz trägt bis heute denselben Namen.
localizedStory.en: A church has stood on this square since 601. The square still carries the same name.

fruits.name: Église protestante Saint-Pierre-le-Jeune
fruits.story: A church has stood on this square since 601. The square still carries the same name.

fruits.extendedStory: The church is named for Saint Stephen, and its record begins in the year 800. The building standing here now was opened in 1300. It is Romanesque, so the arches are round and the walls thick. Gothic went the other way, pointed and thin. This one sits toward the eastern end of the island, on the Rue de la Courtine.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kirche ist nach Stephanus benannt, und ihr Eintrag beginnt im Jahr 800. Das Gebäude, das heute hier steht, wurde 1300 eröffnet. Es ist romanisch, die Bögen sind also rund und die Mauern dick. Die Gotik ging den anderen Weg, spitz und dünn. Dieses Haus liegt am östlichen Ende der Insel, an der Rue de la Courtine.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The church is named for Saint Stephen, and its record begins in the year 800. The building standing here now was opened in 1300. It is Romanesque, so the arches are round and the walls thick. Gothic went the other way, pointed and thin. This one sits toward the eastern end of the island, on the Rue de la Courtine.

localizedStory.de: Der Eintrag für diese Kirche beginnt im Jahr 800. Was hier steht, wurde 1300 eröffnet.
localizedStory.en: The record for this church starts in the year 800. What stands here was opened in 1300.

fruits.name: Église Saint-Étienne
fruits.story: The record for this church starts in the year 800. What stands here was opened in 1300.

fruits.extendedStory: The prefecture was built in 1736 to a design by Joseph Massol. Massol had a busy year. The city hall on this island carries the same date and the same hand. This one he built in the classical style, which means straight lines and plain columns. It stands close to the opera house, on the north side of the island.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Präfektur entstand 1736 nach einem Entwurf von Joseph Massol. Massol hatte ein volles Jahr. Das Rathaus auf dieser Insel trägt dasselbe Datum und dieselbe Handschrift. Dieses Haus baute er klassizistisch, also mit geraden Linien und schlichten Säulen. Es steht nahe beim Opernhaus, im Norden der Insel.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The prefecture was built in 1736 to a design by Joseph Massol. Massol had a busy year. The city hall on this island carries the same date and the same hand. This one he built in the classical style, which means straight lines and plain columns. It stands close to the opera house, on the north side of the island.

localizedStory.de: Joseph Massol baute es 1736, und zwar klassizistisch. Gerade Linien, schlichte Säulen, nichts Verspieltes.
localizedStory.en: Joseph Massol built this in 1736, and he built it classical. Straight lines, plain columns, nothing fussy.

fruits.name: Hôtel de la Préfecture
fruits.story: Joseph Massol built this in 1736, and he built it classical. Straight lines, plain columns, nothing fussy.

fruits.extendedStory: The church is named for Saint Peter, and 1381 is the date it carries. Old is in its name because the city has a second Saint Peter's, the young one. This one is Gothic, with the pointed arches and tall windows of that style. It stands on the Grand'Rue, the long street that runs the length of this end of the island.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kirche ist nach Petrus benannt, und sie trägt das Datum 1381. Alt steht im Namen, weil die Stadt eine zweite Peterskirche hat, die junge. Diese hier ist gotisch, mit den spitzen Bögen und hohen Fenstern dieses Stils. Sie steht an der Grand'Rue, der langen Straße, die dieses Ende der Insel durchzieht.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The church is named for Saint Peter, and 1381 is the date it carries. Old is in its name because the city has a second Saint Peter's, the young one. This one is Gothic, with the pointed arches and tall windows of that style. It stands on the Grand'Rue, the long street that runs the length of this end of the island.

localizedStory.de: Alt Sankt Peter, datiert 1381. Es gibt auch ein Jung Sankt Peter, weiter oben auf der Insel.
localizedStory.en: The old Saint Peter's, dated 1381. There is a young Saint Peter's too, further up the island.

fruits.name: Église Saint-Pierre-le-Vieux
fruits.story: The old Saint Peter's, dated 1381. There is a young Saint Peter's too, further up the island.
